comment:
* Wraps a byte array, providing methods that allow it to be read as a NAL unit bitstream. * *

Whenever the byte sequence [0, 0, 3] appears in the wrapped byte array, it is treated as [0, * 0] for all reading/skipping operations, which makes the bitstream appear to be unescaped.

variables.name: byteOffset
variables.comment: The byte offset is never equal to the offset of the 3rd byte in a subsequence [0, 0, 3].

methods.name: public void reset(byte[] data, int offset, int limit)
methods.comment:
* Resets the wrapped data, limit and offset.
   *
   * @param data The data to wrap.
   * @param offset The byte offset in {@code data} to start reading from.
   * @param limit The byte offset of the end of the bitstream in {@code data}.

methods.name: public void skipBits(int numBits)
methods.comment:
* Skips bits and moves current reading position forward.
   *
   * @param numBits The number of bits to skip.

methods.name: public boolean canReadBits(int numBits)
methods.comment:
* Returns whether it's possible to read {@code n} bits starting from the current offset. The
   * offset is not modified.
   *
   * @param numBits The number of bits.
   * @return Whether it is possible to read {@code n} bits.

methods.name: public boolean readBit()
methods.comment:
* Reads a single bit.
   *
   * @return Whether the bit is set.

methods.name: public int readBits(int numBits)
methods.comment:
* Reads up to 32 bits.
   *
   * @param numBits The number of bits to read.
   * @return An integer whose bottom n bits hold the read data.

methods.name: public boolean canReadExpGolombCodedNum()
methods.comment:
* Returns whether it is possible to read an Exp-Golomb-coded integer starting from the current
   * offset. The offset is not modified.
   *
   * @return Whether it is possible to read an Exp-Golomb-coded integer.

methods.name: public int readUnsignedExpGolombCodedInt()
methods.comment:
* Reads an unsigned Exp-Golomb-coded format integer.
   *
   * @return The value of the parsed Exp-Golomb-coded integer.

methods.name: public int readSignedExpGolombCodedInt()
methods.comment:
* Reads an signed Exp-Golomb-coded format integer.
   *
   * @return The value of the parsed Exp-Golomb-coded integer.

methodNames: public void reset(byte[] data, int offset, int limit)
